title: Rademacher's theorem for maps locally Lipschitz on an open subset of ℝⁿ (Simon Ch. 2, Thm 1.4 localized as in (4.8); parent Steps 2–4)
statement: Let n, p ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ ℝⁿ open and g : ℝⁿ → ℝᵖ locally Lipschitz on W (every x ∈ W has a neighbourhood within W on which g is Lipschitz). Then g is (Fréchet) differentiable at Lⁿ-almost every point of W, i.e. Lⁿ({u ∈ W : g is not differentiable at u}) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (W : Set (Rn n)) (g : Rn n → Rn p), IsOpen W → LocallyLipschitzOn W g → ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), u ∈ W → DifferentiableAt ℝ g u
